name: byond-devtools-vscode
description: Read-only preview of BYOND .dmm maps: rendered tiles from the native type tree, cell inspection and diagnostics.

byondDevtools.byondBin.description: BYOND bin folder (with DreamMaker/dm.exe). Used to read the project's type tree with DreamMaker -o.

byondDevtools.typeTree.description: A saved type tree (DreamMaker -o output) to use instead of running DreamMaker. Relative to the workspace folder.

byondDevtools.dme.description: The project .dme, relative to the workspace folder. Default: the only .dme at the folder root.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies --out byond-map-preview.vsix
